title: Consolidation: Central European Political Thought: Széchenyi, Eötvös, Polányi, Bibó

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can summarize the philosophical legacies of Széchenyi, Eötvös, Karl and Michael Polányi, and Bibó.
I can fluently employ cleft identificational formulas (az nem más, mint; éppen az, ami; abban rejlik, hogy) in analytical writing.
I can construct causal and instrumental subordination with abból adódóan, hogy... and azáltal, hogy...
